comment: cmd.c end_of_input() witness for the tutorial (5193-5194). The tutorial option starts the game in the tutorial level. ^A repeats farlook, whose getpos() reads twenty-one 0377 bytes through pgetchar(), so readchar_core() calls hangup(). The next moveloop_core() calls end_of_input(), which clears something_worth_saving because the hero is in the tutorial, so the game ends without a save.
